verdict: PASS for actual pretrained two-block cross-VM pipeline inference on A100; full 688B deployment remains UNVERIFIED.

scope.hardware: Two Azure Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4 Spot VMs, one NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe SM80 per VM.
scope.partition: Rank0 evaluates decoder block0; rank1 evaluates decoder block1, including its complete 256-expert bank.
scope.reference: Rank1 additionally holds block0 solely for a serial reference using the same custom inference path.
scope.transport: NCCL over private VNet TCP, not RDMA or InfiniBand.
not_tested: Final normalization, LM head, generated answers or task quality
Production API, concurrent serving, pipeline microbatch scheduler or throughput SLA
Tensor parallelism or cross-node expert parallelism

implementation.engine: Pinned Transformers AXK2 plus experimental checkpoint loader, FP8 expert storage/FP32 arithmetic, and two-stage NCCL driver.
implementation.checkpoint_modification: No retraining or replacement learned weights. Stored FP8 values/scales are expanded for FP32 execution.
implementation.attention: Eager sparse-attention semantics using FP32 computation; not the unsupported SKT sparse CUDA kernel.
loader_fixes: Handle partial 128x128 FP8 blocks: actual kv_a_proj_with_mqa weight576x7168 has scale grid5x56. Pinned official dequantizer rejected this shape.
Load original e_score_correction_bias router buffer in addition to named parameters; never substitute initialized zeros.
Require complete checkpoint tensor consumption, matching tensor shapes, no remaining meta tensors, and per-tensor SHA256 validation.
implementation.tail_block_validation: CPU tile-by-tile reference and CUDA expansion agree exactly; aligned blocks match the pinned official converter.
implementation.official_vllm_status: Unmodified pinned SKT vLLM remains unsupported on SM80. This experiment does not change that conclusion.

results.cached_input_tokens: 8 for 256-token cases; 32 for 4096/8192-token cases. These are input tokens, not generated answers.
results.inputs: Four random-token cases using real embedding rows and three cases using actual tokenizer IDs/embeddings of repeated synthetic Korean/English text.
results.memory_caveat: Includes rank1 serial-reference block0 and validation allocations; not a full-model memory estimate.
results.timing_caveat: Only two blocks, sequential pipeline with synchronization and output copies. Do not extrapolate to full-model generation tokens/second.

remaining_limitations: Serial reference shares the custom loader/operators; exact cross-node parity does not independently prove equivalence to the official H100 engine.
Earlier random-model 8K strict-tolerance failure remains valid historical evidence; passing current real-two-block cases is not universal numerical stability.
Two 80GB GPUs cannot hold the complete approximately 656GiB FP8 checkpoint in GPU memory.
Theoretical checkpoint-size arithmetic alone does not determine a feasible full-model node count; workspaces, FP32 expansion, embeddings, KV cache and context length require additional capacity.
next_action: Before any full-model cloud allocation, design and price an end-to-end 61-block trial with measured workspace constraints and obtain separate explicit approval.
cost: Actual billed amount is not yet available. Approved two-node compute ceiling was approximately USD14.70 plus disk/network; this is not an invoice.
cleanup: Consult dist-cleanup-confirmation.json for the verified deletion timestamp; both VMs were deallocated before group deletion.
